verdict.rationale: The evidence describes Thoropass exposing its own MCP server so external AI assistants can connect to and use Thoropass's tools (docs-28, docs-52, probe-2) — this is the opposite direction of the story, which asks whether Thoropass itself can plug into external MCP servers to consume their tools. No evidence shows Thoropass acting as an MCP client that connects to third-party MCP servers.
